SELECT c.club_id as clubId, c.name as clubName,
-- 동아리별 회원 수 COALESCE(member_stats.memberCount, 0) as memberCount,
-- 활동내역 게시글 수 COALESCE(activity_stats.activityPostCount, 0) as activityPostCount,
-- 활동내역 게시글의 댓글 수 COALESCE(comment_stats.activityCommentCount, 0) as activityCommentCount,
-- 활동내역 게시글 및 댓글의 좋아요 수 COALESCE(like_stats.activityLikeCount, 0) as activityLikeCount,
-- 총합 조회수 (동아리 조회수 + 모집글 조회수) (COALESCE(c.views, 0) + COALESCE(recruitment_stats.recruitmentViews, 0)) as totalViews,
-- 동아리 조회수 COALESCE(c.views, 0) as clubViews,
-- 동아리 모집 조회수 COALESCE(recruitment_stats.recruitmentViews, 0) as clubRecruitmentViews,
-- 최근 3일간 들어온 유저 수 COALESCE(recent_participant_stats.recentParticipantCount, 0) as recentParticipantCount
FROM club c
-- 동아리별 회원 수 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cm.club_id, COUNT(*) as memberCount FROM club_member cm WHERE cm.deleted_date_time IS NULL GROUP BY cm.club_id ) member_stats ON c.club_id = member_stats.club_id
-- 활동내역 게시글 수 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ca.club_id, COUNT(*) as activityPostCount FROM club_activity ca WHERE ca.deleted_date_time IS NULL GROUP BY ca.club_id ) activity_stats ON c.club_id = activity_stats.club_id
-- 활동내역 댓글 수 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ca.club_id, COUNT(cac.club_activity_comment_id) as activityCommentCount FROM club_activity ca LEFT JOIN club_activity_comment cac ON ca.club_activity_id = cac.club_activity_id AND cac.deleted_date_time IS NULL WHERE ca.deleted_date_time IS NULL GROUP BY ca.club_id ) comment_stats ON c.club_id = comment_stats.club_id
-- 활동내역 게시글 좋아요 수 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ca.club_id, COUNT(cal.club_activity_like_id) as activityLikeCount FROM club_activity ca LEFT JOIN club_activity_like cal ON ca.club_activity_id = cal.club_activity_id AND cal.deleted_date_time IS NULL WHERE ca.deleted_date_time IS NULL GROUP BY ca.club_id ) like_stats ON c.club_id = like_stats.club_id
-- 모집글 조회수 합계 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT r.club_id, SUM(COALESCE(r.views, 0)) as recruitmentViews FROM recruitment r WHERE r.deleted_date_time IS NULL GROUP BY r.club_id ) recruitment_stats ON c.club_id = recruitment_stats.club_id
-- 최근 3일간 참여자 수 (club_member 기준) LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cm.club_id, COUNT(DISTINCT cm.member_id) as recentParticipantCount FROM club_member cm WHERE cm.deleted_date_time IS NULL AND cm.created_date_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 3 DAY) GROUP BY cm.club_id ) recent_participant_stats ON c.club_id = recent_participant_stats.club_id
WHERE c.deleted_date_time IS NULL ORDER BY c.club_id
